response.rationale: Pistol is ranged, matching the plan's weapon_type, and scores highest (22). It fits the 14 gold budget and fills a weapon slot with a Gun-set piece. Shuriken is a Precise-set crit weapon and costs more.
Alien Worm adds +3 max HP and +2 HP regen for 25 gold, matching the plan's max_hp and regen weights and the survival goal. Cactus Mace is melee against a ranged plan. Injection costs max HP.

Armor is weighted 4 in the plan and is the only offered stat that matches it. Speed and luck are off-plan. HP regen is already at 2, so its weight is covered. Armor adds survival for the uncorrupted run.
Cyclops Worm gives +12 percent damage, the highest advisor score, and fits the plan's stat_percent_damage weight. Affordable at 78 of 204 gold. Range -12 is a minor cost for a kiting ranged build.
Plan weights crit chance (4.5) and it has the only nonzero advisor score. Melee damage is off-plan for a ranged build. Range and luck are not in the plan weights.
Leather Vest fits the plan's armor and dodge weights (advisor score 9), costs 94 of 310 gold. Alien Eyes and Ice Cube score 0; the Jousting Lance is melee, off-plan.
Ranged SMG fits the plan's ranged kiting. Affordable at 204 gold. Advisor scores it 105, far above the alternatives. Melee options are off-plan and the item is weak. Buy.

Pile Of Books adds crit chance (+5), which the plan weights at 4.5, and the advisor scores it highest. It costs 130 of 289 gold. Alien Eyes is a max-HP option, but its effect is unclear and it costs more.
Third Pistol T3 combines with the two owned, tiering up to T4 and freeing slots on a full board. Ranged plan, Gun set range bonus, and affordable at 100 of 364 gold.

Butterfly adds lifesteal (plan weight 6) at 78 gold, highest advisor score. Little Muscley Dude hurts ranged range (-15) and is melee-oriented; Ghost Scepter is off-plan with weapons already at 6 cap.

Armor is the highest advisor score (12) and the plan weights armor (4) above dodge (3) and crit (4.5 but offense already covered). Full HP at wave 13 with a ranged kit; armor adds durable defense for the uncorrupted run.

Sunglasses adds +10 crit chance, which the plan weights at 4.5, and the advisor scores it highest at 11. Its -1 armor is a small cost. Scope's -7 attack speed works against the plan's attack speed weight of 7. Affordable at 295 gold.
Plan weights hp_regeneration (2) and survival matters for the uncorrupted target. Regen +4 has the top advisor score and fits the plan. Speed is off-plan and luck is off-plan.
Gentle Alien best fits plan weights: +5% percent damage and +2 max HP, both favoured. Its extra enemies are a real risk, but gold covers it. Injection's -2 max HP is worse for survival.

Survival is the priority for the uncorrupted run. Max HP is only 40, so +6 max HP adds a large buffer. Armor +3 scores higher but max HP matches the plan's weighting and the target. Range and melee are off-plan.
Scope is ranged and adds ranged damage and range, matching the ranged plan with the highest advisor score. Its -7 attack speed is a cost, but the other options are off-plan or melee. Gold covers it.

Ashes adds +20% percent damage, +20 attack speed and +100 range, all plan stats, and the advisor rates it highest. Affordable at 387 gold. Its -1 armor per wave is a drawback. Ghost Scepter is not useful with 6 weapons held.
Plan favours ranged. Buying DBS_2 combines with the two owned DBS_2 into a DBS_3 (advisor 105). Affordable at 112 of 380 gold. Keeps the ranged damage and attack-speed build, and the slot is locked.

Leather Vest matches the plan's armor and dodge weights and is the only advisor-scored option. It costs 133, affordable. Tardigrade is a strong alternative at 146 but is off-plan. Survival matters at wave 16.
Highest advisor score (8.3) and affordable at 447 gold. Adds max HP (plan stat) for survival. Melee damage and -15 range are minor drawbacks versus the ranged plan. Stick and bell are weak options.
Advisor scores SMG_3 at 110 (combine-level), far above the other options. Ranged plan fits it, and 216 is affordable at 253 gold. Board-full combine status is unverified, so confidence is moderate.

Medal is the only offer that matches the plan's weights: max HP, percent damage and armor, plus speed. Its -4 crit is a small cost. It is affordable at 172 of 326 gold. Fresh Meat's regen penalty conflicts with the plan.
Highest advisor score (15.6) and plan weight stat_percent_damage 6.5 fits a ranged build. Harvesting is already 75, past the harvest_cap of 40, so skip it. Max HP 53 is adequate.
Leather Vest (advisor 9, above min_buy 6) adds armor and dodge, both in plan weights. Affordable at 149 of 321 gold. Its -3 max HP is a cost, but the other offers score 0 or 7 and are off-plan.
